meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会指导你直接调用Microsoft Graph API，创建和管理AI代理的身份对象（Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、Agent Identity），并配置OAuth 2.0令牌交换（如fmi_path、OBO），必要时搜索Microsoft Learn文档来核对请求格式。
howto.when: 当提到创建Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal，或配置代理的OAuth令牌交换（如fmi_path、OBO）等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个Agent Identity Blueprint
为我的代理配置fmi_path令牌交换
say.note: Claude会给出两阶段令牌交换的步骤和代码。
Claude会生成创建服务主体和分配应用权限的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to directly call Microsoft Graph API to create and manage AI agent identity objects (Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, Agent Identity), configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (e.g., fmi_path, OBO), and search Microsoft Learn docs when needed to verify request formats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention creating Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, or configuring agent OAuth token exchange (e.g., fmi_path, OBO).

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint for me
say_en.note: Claude will call Graph API and remind you to create the BlueprintPrincipal.

say_en.text: Set up fmi_path token exchange for my agent
say_en.note: Claude provides the two-step exchange steps and code.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity and grant User.Read.All
